name: Deflecting Swat

covers.line: If you control a commander, you may cast ~ without paying its mana cost.

abilities.text: You may choose new targets for target spell or ability.

notes: The free cast is an altCost with no mana and the condition controls-commander: legal.ts:325 checks alt.condition before offering the variant, and an altCost whose cost carries no mana is free. Its oracle line cannot be CLAIMED, though - COVER_RULES.altCosts only matches the "you may ... rather than pay ~ mana cost" wording, not the free-spell cycle wording "you may cast ~ without paying its mana cost" - so the line stays unparsed even though the declaration behind it is right.
